<documents>
<document id="transfers-returned">
ReturnedˆtransfersˆSometimesˆaˆtransferˆisˆsentˆback.ˆThisˆisˆcalledˆaˆreturn.ˆItˆusuallyˆhappensˆaˆfewˆbusinessˆdaysˆafterˆtheˆtransferˆwasˆsent.ˆ##ˆCommonˆreasonsˆ-ˆTheˆaccountˆnumberˆorˆroutingˆnumberˆwasˆwrong.ˆ-ˆTheˆreceivingˆaccountˆwasˆclosedˆorˆfrozen.ˆ-ˆTheˆnameˆonˆtheˆreceivingˆaccountˆdidn'tˆmatch.ˆ-ˆForˆmoneyˆyouˆpulledˆinˆfromˆanotherˆbank,ˆthereˆwasn'tˆenoughˆmoneyˆinˆthatˆaccount.ˆ##ˆWhatˆhappensˆtoˆtheˆmoneyˆForˆtransfersˆout,ˆtheˆmoneyˆcomesˆbackˆtoˆyourˆTallowbrookˆbalanceˆwhenˆtheˆreturnˆreachesˆus.ˆForˆtransfersˆin,ˆweˆtakeˆbackˆanyˆamountˆweˆalreadyˆmadeˆavailable.ˆ##ˆFeesˆWeˆdon'tˆchargeˆforˆreturnedˆtransfersˆ($0.00).ˆTheˆotherˆbankˆmight.ˆ##ˆWhatˆtoˆdoˆCheckˆtheˆdetailsˆonˆtheˆlinkedˆaccount,ˆcorrectˆanythingˆwrong,ˆandˆsendˆtheˆtransferˆagain.ˆIfˆaˆpullˆfromˆyourˆownˆaccountˆatˆanotherˆbankˆwasˆreturned,ˆaskˆthatˆbankˆwhyˆbeforeˆyouˆtryˆagain.ˆRepeatedˆreturnsˆcanˆleadˆtoˆlowerˆtransferˆamounts.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="atm-surcharges">
ATMˆownerˆsurchargesˆandˆourˆfeesˆWhenˆyouˆuseˆanˆATMˆoutsideˆBrookLink,ˆupˆtoˆtwoˆdifferentˆchargesˆcanˆapply.ˆThey'reˆeasyˆtoˆmixˆup.ˆ##ˆTheˆATMˆowner'sˆsurchargeˆThisˆisˆsetˆbyˆwhoeverˆownsˆtheˆATM,ˆnotˆbyˆus.ˆTheˆATMˆshowsˆitˆonˆscreenˆbeforeˆyouˆconfirm,ˆandˆit'sˆaddedˆtoˆtheˆwithdrawalˆamount.ˆForˆexample,ˆifˆyouˆwithdrawˆcashˆandˆtheˆownerˆchargesˆaˆsurcharge,ˆoneˆtransactionˆforˆtheˆtotalˆappearsˆinˆyourˆactivity.ˆ##ˆTallowbrook'sˆout-of-networkˆfeeˆThisˆisˆourˆfee,ˆchargedˆasˆaˆseparateˆlineˆcalledˆ"Out-of-networkˆATMˆfee".ˆIt'sˆ$2.50ˆonˆBasicˆandˆonˆPlusˆafterˆyourˆfreeˆwithdrawals,ˆandˆfreeˆonˆPremium.ˆ##ˆPremiumˆsurchargeˆreimbursementˆPremiumˆpaysˆbackˆATMˆownerˆsurchargesˆupˆtoˆ$10.00ˆperˆcalendarˆmonth.ˆTheˆrefundˆisˆcreditedˆautomaticallyˆonˆtheˆfirstˆbusinessˆdayˆofˆtheˆnextˆmonth.ˆ##ˆAvoidingˆbothˆUseˆaˆBrookLinkˆATM.ˆTheyˆneverˆchargeˆaˆsurcharge,ˆandˆweˆneverˆchargeˆaˆfeeˆforˆthem.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="fx-fees-premium">
ForeignˆtransactionˆfeesˆonˆPremiumˆOnˆtheˆPremiumˆplan,ˆtheˆforeignˆtransactionˆfeeˆisˆ0%ˆofˆtheˆpurchaseˆamountˆinˆUSˆdollars.ˆ##ˆWhenˆitˆappliesˆ-ˆPurchasesˆinˆaˆforeignˆcurrency,ˆinˆaˆstoreˆorˆonlineˆ-ˆPurchasesˆinˆUSˆdollarsˆprocessedˆbyˆaˆmerchantˆoutsideˆtheˆUSˆItˆdoesn'tˆapplyˆtoˆATMˆwithdrawalsˆabroad.ˆThoseˆhaveˆtheˆinternationalˆATMˆfeeˆinstead.ˆ##ˆExampleˆOnˆPremium,ˆaˆpurchaseˆabroadˆcostsˆexactlyˆtheˆconvertedˆamount.ˆNoˆfeeˆisˆadded.ˆ##ˆExchangeˆrateˆWeˆuseˆtheˆcardˆnetwork'sˆrateˆonˆtheˆdayˆtheˆtransactionˆsettles,ˆwithˆnoˆmarkup.ˆChooseˆtheˆlocalˆcurrencyˆwhenˆaˆterminalˆoffersˆtoˆchargeˆyouˆinˆdollars.ˆ##ˆRefundsˆIfˆaˆforeignˆpurchaseˆisˆrefunded,ˆweˆalsoˆrefundˆtheˆforeignˆtransactionˆfeeˆonˆtheˆrefundedˆamount.ˆTheˆrefundˆisˆconvertedˆatˆtheˆrateˆonˆtheˆdayˆitˆsettles.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
</documents>

Customer question: Does Premium charge anything to use another bank's ATM?
